bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
n=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = true || exit 81
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$n")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' create-videobot:menu-edit-f86b8a7)" || exit 82
count="$(docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' "$n")"
sleep 9
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = true || exit 83
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' "$n")" = "$count" || exit 84
docker logs --tail 500 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || exit 85
docker logs --tail 500 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_GATE_PUBLIC_RELEASE=CONNECTED$' || exit 86
pg=deploy-postgres-1
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
state="$(docker exec "$pg" psql -U "$user" -d videobot -Atc "SELECT status||':'||handled FROM videobot_webhook_updates WHERE update_id=2956732")"
test "$state" = completed:true || exit 87
cursor="$(docker exec "$pg" psql -U "$user" -d videobot -Atc "SELECT last_update_id FROM videobot_poll_cursor WHERE consumer_id='createvdobot'")"
test "$cursor" -ge 2956732 || exit 88
echo POST_RECOVERY_STABLE=PASS
echo NAVIGATION_RECEIPT_DURABLE=PASS
echo SINGLE_BOT_IMAGE=PASS
